name: HTML Formatter
summary: Beautify messy HTML with consistent indentation — entirely in your browser.
description: Paste HTML to pretty-print nested tags with configurable indent. Optionally minify back into the input. Formatting runs locally with no upload.

faqs.question: Does it validate HTML?
faqs.answer: No. It focuses on indentation and readability. Invalid markup is still formatted best-effort.

faqs.question: Are script and style contents reformatted?
faqs.answer: Their inner content is preserved as-is so you do not accidentally break embedded code.

faqs.question: Is my HTML uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser.
